About

An energetic, driven entrepreneur and marketing specialist who is keen on creating new marketing and business opportunities by combining and developing new IT solutions which could bring happiness into the lives of fans and event organisers, brands alike.

Founder & CEO of 'Seyu - Together for victory!' which is a technology solution for sports fans that enables them to motivate their favorite teams or athletes from anywhere in the world. The company uses partners’ existing IT infrastructure to allow fans around the world to post images to stadium LEDs and other digital surfaces during sports events or feature the live broadcast through a moderated channel and then instantly share them on social media with media-branded frames. The service, which has been proven to be successful at more than 1000 sports and lifestyle events, is one of the leading sports tech services in Europe, and lovers of international sports are regularly able to enjoy its benefits as well in 33 countries.

    Step by step...I am delighted that industry experts at one of 'The Big 4' are already share our vision for the next gen engagement of fans in the intersections of smart sponsorship campaigns and bull's-eye precision value proposition by right holders.💪

    'Seyu - Together for victory!'​

    6mo • Edited •

    We’re entering a strategic partnership with EY-Parthenon Hungary, one of the world’s most respected strategy consultancies.
    For us, this is more than a logo next to a logo.
    It’s a shared belief that modern sport needs measurable, brand-safe, and scalable ways to:

     • Activate sponsors with real fan participation (not passive impressions)
     • Turn engagement into intelligence (GDPR-compliant insights that actually help decision-making)
     • Create new commercial assets that work in-stadium and remotely—across leagues, venues, and markets

    Seyu was built to help rights holders and brands win together: real-time fan content, moderated and broadcast-ready, deployed on existing screens—plug & play.

    Partnering with EY-Parthenon Hungary is a strong signal that the market is moving from “engagement ideas” to engagement systems that deliver outcomes.

    Special thanks to     Person 12 - Partner, Head of EY-Parthenon Hungary Strategy & Execution team -, Person 13 and Person 14, for their key role in bringing this partnership to life.

    Looking forward to the journey ahead together.

    6mo •

    We are delighted to share with you that a boutique marketing company, Xela Solutions Ltd. has replaced in Seyu our long-term, domestic investor, Hiventures.

    The merger will see our company taking advantage of Xela Solutions Ltd.’s partner network of international brands, actively seeking opportunities in sport to connect with sport fans, and turn some of that 400 million supporters (59% of Europe) into their customers.

    “This deal will provide us with an opportunity to tap into a pool of 80+ international brands and charities, and usher them to Seyu’s right holder partners across our portfolio in 42 countries as an ideal marketing path to sport fans.” - commented our CEO, Tom Anna Anna.

    The new ownership structure and 2026 will bring an exciting new chapter in the life of our company. A chapter that will benefit our partners and enhance fan experience for millions of fans.

    Together for victory!

    We extend our sincere gratitude to Hiventures Zrt. and its colleagues for their vital past contributions in establishing Seyu on the global stages of sport tech, ad tech, and big data.

    7mo •

    So happy to see my friends, business friends and people I care for in a wider circle closing an awesome year and taking steps towards the goals that they set for themselves. Delighted for everybody’s progress. 👏 Wishing you all a wonderful and similarly prosperous New Year ahead!🫶

    As for my year, if I have to narrow it down to really major goals and achievements that I set for myself, we managed to accomplish 4 out 5 significant goals (from Seyu’s and my life’s perspective). Did considerably okay, I guess. 😀

    🚀Completed an M&A transaction and replaced our main former investor by an agency who works with major brands in Europe
    🚀Freed Seyu’s financials from a burden that blocked participations in EU tenders, and closing the 5th year of steady revenue growth post 2020
    🚀Signed prime deals & strengthened our Team
    🚀Completed an annual number of record service events across 42 countries (7 new markets, entering 72% of EU countries so far), continuous YoY growth since 2020 
    ▶️Watch out for the fifth goal soon to come😉

    Although it looks all nice and gloomy as I write this list above… but everyone who ever built a company or had the fortune to build a company that brings to life a new product or service, would figure that it was a hell of a fight in ourselves, in the office and out there on the market. Which we embrace culturally at Seyu.🤜🤛

    Phil Knight in Nike’s credo states that "It won’t be pretty!”, it did not make much sense up until now, or it did, just got an extended meaning in my business life in 2025. His words provide me with a comfort that hard decisions are part of the journey of company building and self growth as an individual and as an entrepreneur. Although it is always very hard to set my heart aside when tough calls are made, and I hope it will remain just as hard in the future, maintaining that emotional link that makes us human.

    🍾🥂So, here is to you all ‘Go Getters’ in my business social circle and let’s keep pushing forward in 2026 to achieve those “Big Hairy Audacious Goals”❗️

    'Seyu - Together for victory!'​

    8mo •

    🏆 Silver Award at Sport Forum Hungary 2025! 🏆

    Thrilled to share that Seyu has won Silver in the “Best Sports Innovation & AI” category at this year’s Sport Forum Hungary! 🤖💡

    Our submission highlighted our Leather Magic, the ‘virtual jersey’ experience we brought to life at the     MotoGP™ Hungarian GP at Balaton Park Circuit.🏍️⚡

    With our new AI-powered solution, fans could instantly “dress up” as their favourite riders like never before in their lives and share with the world how they were flexing as a pro MotoGP rider — making their race-day experience even more immersive and fun.

    Hungarian fans were also gifted with the opportunity to ‘try-on’ Person 16 MotoGP World Champion leather which he was wearing back in 2007, as a little ‘time-travel’ experience.

    This project came together thanks to the amazing collaboration with Lounge Event and Nemzeti Rendezvényszervező Ügynökség Nonprofit Zrt.🤝✨

    A huge shoutout to everyone involved for the teamwork and creative energy! A special thank you goes for the Polish fan who brought us two beers in his happiness after the experience.

    We’re proud of the recognition and even more excited to keep pushing boundaries in sports tech. 🚀

    #Seyu #SportTech #AI #Innovation #MotoGP #FanExperience #LeatherMagic #SportForumHungary

    What an amazing 24 hours spent in Warsaw this week for the invitation of PZPN (Polski Związek Piłki Nożnej) head of innovation Person 17.🙏

    Comment if you are on the photo!🙂🫶

    A friendly environment created by PZPN Innovation Hub for industry experts, eager to elevate their daily work thanks to digitalisation. Besides the intriguing conversations with many, similarly exciting presentations from LaSource, Sceenic, Waveplus IO and Sportian brightened the day.🔥

    I also had my chance to chip in, amongst the above listed giants, and talk about 'Seyu - Together for victory!'​ ability to lock match days into the hearts of fans in stadia, and beyond.📸

    One of the eye-opening Polish national football team relevant insights that I shared with my attentive and cheerful audience was the fact that the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 match of Poland vs Argentina was watched by 20.5 million fans only in Poland, yet in the stadiums were roughly half of the 44k seats taken by Polish fans, meaning 99.99% fans in Poland had no chance to show their devotion to Robert Lewandowski and his team or connect with fellow fans. Imagine if FIFA or PZPN (Polski Związek Piłki Nożnej) had Seyu in place to provide a platform to fans to show their devotion with a fan photo and in the process gather millions of user data besides the authentic, branded and real-time supervised social media exposure. 💡
    Wonder if FIFA World Cup 2026™ - Canada, Mexico and the United States will cater for the billions of fans globally... 🤔
